summary: BESLENCE AI iteration 9 (subscription gating + reminders + push + delete-account + manual add UX) — VERIFIED. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass against https://ai-food-logger-2.preview.emergentagent.com (Bearer test_session_macros_001). Frontend: FREE + PRO gating flows end-to-end on mobile (390x844) via localStorage token injection. BACKEND details: (1) SUBSCRIPTION — GET /api/subscription/me returns {tier:'free',is_pro:false} after POST /api/subscription/sync {is_pro:false}; sync {is_pro:true,expires_at,store} flips to tier=pro; POST /api/webhooks/revenuecat {event:{type:'EXPIRATION',app_user_id:'test_user_macros'}} flips back to free; INITIAL_PURCHASE flips to pro. (2) DELETE ACCOUNT — Seeded disposable user + session (expires_at as datetime) + entry directly into Mongo (db beslence_ai, collections users/user_sessions/entries). DELETE /api/auth/account returns {ok:true,deleted:true}. Token invalidated (subsequent /api/auth/me → 401). Mongo verified: users doc, session doc, and all entries for that user_id are all removed. (3) REMINDER — POST /api/entries entry_type='reminder', meal_type='hatirlatici', time set 20s in the past → scheduler tick within 30-60s marks notified=True on the entry even though EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY='placeholder' causes send_push to raise (caught non-blocking) — confirmed via GET /api/entries?date=<today>. (4) REGISTER PUSH — POST /api/register-push returns 500 with detail 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' (expected placeholder-key PASS behavior). (5) MACROS REGRESSION — PATCH /api/entries/{id}/macros with P=30,C=40,F=10 returns calories=370 (=4·30+4·40+9·10); persistence verified via GET. /api/summary/daily and /api/report/daily still 200. FRONTEND details (mobile 390x844, token injected via localStorage.setItem('beslence_session_token', '"test_session_macros_001"')): FREE FLOW — visiting /chatbot redirects to /paywall; visiting /report redirects to /paywall; paywall shows ₺299, '3 GÜN ÜCRETSİZ DENE' badge, paywall-subscribe button; tab-add opens /add (manual entry), NOT chatbot; tap add-manual-btn opens manual-food-modal; fill name/P=30/C=40/F=10 → manual-food-kcal renders '370 kcal'; save → add-saved-card appears; entry created via PATCH /macros path in ManualFoodModal. Calendar: cal-add-reminder opens reminder-modal; save with title 'Test hatırlatıcı', 23:45 → modal closes, verified reminder entry (title, time=23:45, meal_type=hatirlatici) exists via GET /api/entries; week-day-* cells rendered = 7. Profile: sportif dark theme rendered, profile-subscription card ('Ücretsiz Sürüm' + 3-gün upsell) and delete-account-btn both visible (NOT tapped to preserve session). PRO FLOW — after sync {is_pro:true} + reload: /chatbot stays on chatbot (no redirect), /report renders the report page (three date chips visible: 'Pzt 20 Tem', 'Paz 19 Tem', 'Cmt 18 Tem'; dayChipText fontSize 15 confirmed in report.tsx L224), and tab-add now routes to /chatbot instead of /add. Cleanup: session token flipped back to free at teardown; test-created entries and disposable user deleted.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated web-only warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents); Invalid DOM property transform-origin (use transformOrigin). These are web-shim warnings from RN elements; on native they are silent. Reference: many components using shadow* props in tabs/_layout.tsx L119-121 and elsewhere.
'[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — expected and safe. Push is native-only; web preview registers no device token. No action needed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUSH scheduler (L622-664): places `notified=True` update AFTER send_push in try/except — placeholder-key HTTPException(500) is caught by outer while-loop's `except Exception` (line 662). BUT: send_push raises `HTTPException` on 401, which propagates through the inner try to the outer except; that path skips the `notified=True` update for that entry on this tick. On next tick 30s later, send_push fails again and, because entry.notified is still not True, it retries. During the reminder test the outer catch happened but the update DID land — confirmed via GET. Consider moving the `db.entries.update_one(..., notified: True)` OUTSIDE the try/except (i.e., always mark handled to avoid duplicate future push attempts once the key becomes valid). This is a minor robustness note, not a bug.

server.py webhook (L703-731): no signature/HMAC verification (only optional bearer REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH env). Fine for MVP but on production add HMAC verification or set REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH in prod.

server.py PATCH /entries/{id}/macros (L534-554): returns `updates` including internal fields — OK; MongoDB _id already excluded via projection pattern elsewhere; the returned `updates` dict is constructed locally so no _id leak.
server.py is now 1480 lines — still above 700-line guideline (flagged since iteration 7). Future refactor: split subscription/webhook, push, chatbot, and report into modules.
Frontend paywall.tsx: subscribe button on web relies on window.alert (works) but no visible fallback banner. Acceptable for web preview.

Frontend _layout.tsx (tabs) L119: uses shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset on web — triggers 'shadow* deprecated, use boxShadow' console warnings. Only cosmetic web-shim noise; on native these are correct. Optional migration to Platform.select boxShadow for web.
Frontend consistently uses testID on all interactive elements per spec — full E2E via [data-testid=...] selectors succeeded on first try.
